description: Repo-scale (kotlin-inventory): POST /api/warehouses/{id}/items/bulk-add must reject the whole batch if the CUMULATIVE quantity would exceed the warehouse's maxCapacity - not check each item against a stale pre-batch baseline
prompts: Warehouses gain an optional `maxCapacity` field (a non-negative integer, or null meaning unlimited) - accept it in POST /api/warehouses and return it in warehouse responses. Add `POST /api/warehouses/{warehouseId}/items/bulk-add`: body `{"items": [{...}, ...]}`, where each item has the same fields as POST /api/items (minus warehouseId, which comes from the path). It must be atomic: validate every item's fields AND sku-uniqueness (against existing items AND against other items earlier in the same batch) before creating anything. Critically, get the capacity check right: the invariant is that the warehouse's total quantity across ALL its items (existing + everything in this batch, combined) must never exceed maxCapacity. Compute the batch's total quantity and compare `existingTotal + batchTotal` against maxCapacity ONCE for the whole batch - do not check each item individually against the pre-batch total, since that lets a batch of several small items sail past a cap that any one of them wouldn't trip alone. Reject the entire batch (nothing created) with 400 if it would overflow.
name: add_kotlin_inventory_bulk_add_cumulative_capacity
